def transform(grid):
    g = np.array(grid)
    n = g.shape[0]
    A = int(g[0, 0])            # corner colour
    B = int(g[0, 1])            # background colour
    C = int(g[n // 2, n // 2])  # centre colour
    seq = [A, C, B]
    N = 2 * n
    out = np.full((N, N), B, dtype=int)
    out[:n, :n] = g
    emit(out, f"Allocate a {N}x{N} canvas and copy the input into the top-left corner.")
    names = {A: "corner colour", C: "centre colour", B: "background colour"}
    for k in range(n, N):
        col = seq[(k - n) % 3]
        out[k, :k] = col
        out[:k, k] = col
        out[k, k] = seq[(k + 1 - n) % 3]
        emit(out, f"Layer {k}: fill row {k} and column {k} with {col} ({names.get(col,'')}); "
                  f"diagonal corner ({k},{k}) takes the next colour in the cycle, {out[k,k]}.")
    return out
